explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/1100: 'Erdős and Simonovits proved (2^{1/2} + o(1))^k < g(k) < (2−c)^k for some constant c > 0.' The Lean statement: (i) for every 0 ≤ r < √2, r^k < g k for all large k, and (ii) ∃ c > 0 with g k < (2−c)^k for all large k. Part (i) is the correct unpacking of the lower bound with base √2 + o(1). Faithful.
